drivingQuestion: Is a very large etrog fit?
outcomeNote: R' Yosei's precedent is dismissed; the underlying mishna dispute stands

segments.he: וּבַגָּדוֹל כְּדֵי שֶׁיֹּאחַז כּוּ׳. תַּנְיָא, אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹסֵי: מַעֲשֶׂה בְּרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא שֶׁבָּא לְבֵית הַכְּנֶסֶת וְאֶתְרוֹגוֹ עַל כְּתֵפוֹ! אָמַר לוֹ רַבִּי יְהוּדָה: מִשָּׁם רְאָיָה? אַף הֵם אָמְרוּ לוֹ: אֵין זֶה הָדָר.
segments.en: The mishna continues: «And in a large» etrog, the maximum measure is «so that one could hold» two in his one hand; this is the statement of Rabbi Yehuda. Rabbi Yosei says: It is fit even if it is so large that he can hold only one in his two hands. «It is taught» in a baraita that «Rabbi Yosei said:» There was «an incident involving Rabbi Akiva, who came to the synagogue, and his etrog» was so large that he carried it «on his shoulder.» Apparently, one can fulfill his obligation with a large etrog. «Rabbi Yehuda said to him:» Is there «proof from there?» In that case, «too,» the Sages «said to him: That is not beauty.»
